(Dhātup. xxvii, 11) हिनोति (Ved. also हिनुते, हिन्वति and हिन्वति, ˚ते; p. हिन्वान [with act. and pass. sense] RV.; हयत्, RV.; TS.; 1. sg. हिषे, RV.; pf. जिघाय, जिघ्युः, Br. &c.; जिघ्ये [with pass. sense] Bhaṭṭ.; aor. अहेम, अह्यन्, हेत p. हियान [with pass. sense] RV.; अह्यम् [?], अहैत्, AV.; अहैषीत्, Br.; अहेषत, RV.; fut. हेता Gr.; हेष्यति, MBh. &c.; inf. -ह्ये, RV.), to send forth, set in motion, impel, urge on, hasten on (Ā. also intrans.), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; to stimulate or incite to (dat.), RV.; to assist or help to (dat.), ib.; to discharge, hurl, cast, shoot, RV.; to convey, bring, procure, ib.; ŚBr.; to forsake, abandon, get rid of Bhaṭṭ.; (हिन्वति) to gladden, delight, Dhātup. xv, 82 : Pass. हीयते (aor. अहायि) Gr.: Caus. हाययति (aor. अजीहयत्), ib. : Desid. of Caus. जिघाययिषति, ib. : Desid. जिघीषति, ib. : Intens. जेघीयते, जेघयीति, जेघेति, ib.

2. हि ind. (used as a particle [cf. ह and घ] and usually denoting) for, because, on account of (never standing first in a sentence, but generally after the first word and used enclitically, sometimes after pronouns; e.g. सर्वो हि पृतना जिगीषति, ‘for everybody wishes to win battles’; भवान् हि प्रमाणम्, ‘for your honour is the authority’; तथा हि, ‘for example’, ‘accordingly’; न हि or नहि, ‘for not’, ‘not at all’), RV. &c. &c.
just, pray, do (with an Impv. or Pot. emphatically; sometimes with Indic., e.g. पश्यामो हि, ‘we will just see’), ib.

indeed, assuredly, surely, of course, certainly (हि वै, ‘most assuredly’; हि-तु or हि-पुनर्, ‘indeed-but’; often a mere expletive, esp. to avoid a hiatus, sometimes repeated in the same sentence; हि is also said to be an interjection of ‘envy’, ‘contempt’, ‘hurry’ &c.), ib.
a: हि — ind. (Never used at the beginning of a sentence) It has the following senses:-- 1 For, because (expressing a strict or logical reason); अग्निरिहास्ति धूमो हि दृश्यते G. M.; R. 5. 10. --2 Indeed, surely; देव प्रयोगप्रधानं हि नाट्यशास्त्रं M. 1; न हि कमलिनीं दृष्ठ्वा ग्राहमवेक्षते मतंगजः M. 3. --3 For instance, as is well known; प्रजानामेव भूत्यर्थं स ताभ्यो बलिमग्रहीत् . सहस्रगुणमुत्स्रष्टुमादत्ते हि रसं रविः R. 1. 18. --4 Only, alone (to emphasize an idea); मूढो हि मदनेनायास्यते K. 155. --5 Sometimes it is used merely as an expletive.

हि — {c5c} P. (हिनोति, हित; caus. हाययति; desid. जिघीषति) 1 To send forth, impel. --2 To cast, throw, discharge, shoot; गदा शक्रजिता जिघ्ये Bk. 14. 36. --3 To excite, incite, urge. --4 To promote, further. --5 To gratify, please, exhilarate. --6 To go or proceed.

s: puM, (hiraRyasya aSvo yatra .) tulApuruzAdi-zoqaSamahAdAnAntargatamahAdAnaviSezaH । yaTA, -- matsya uvAca । “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi hiraRyASvaviDiM param । yasya pradAnAdBuvane AnantyaPalamaSnute ॥ puRyAM tiTiM samAsAdya kftvA brAhmaRavAcanam । lokeSAvAhanaM kuryyAttulApuruzadAnavat ॥ ftviNmaRqapasamBAraBUzaRAcCAdanAdikam । svalpezvekAgnivat kuryyAdDemavAjimaKaM buDaH ॥ sTApayedvedimaDye tu kfzRAjinatilopari । kOSeyavastrasaMvItaM kArayedDemavAjinam ॥ SaktitastripalAdUrdDamAsahasrapalAdbuDaH । pAdukopAnahacCatracAmarAsanaBAjanEH ॥ pUrRakumBAzwakopetaM mAlyekzuPalasaMyutam । SayyAM sopaskarAM tadvadDemamArttaRqasaMyutAm ॥ tataH sarvvOzaDIsnAtaH snApito vedapuNgavEH । imamuccArayenmantraM gfhItakusumAYjaliH ॥ namaste sarvvadeveSa ! vedAharaRalampawa ! । vAjirUpeRa mAmasmAt pAhi saMsArasAgarAt ॥ tvameva saptaDA BUtvA CAyArUpeRa BAskaram । yatnAdBramayase lokAnataH pAhi sanAtana ! ॥ evamuccAryya gurave tamaSvaM vinivedayet । dattvA pApakzayAdBAnorlokamaByeti SvASvatam ॥ goBirviBavataH sarvvAnftvijaScApi pUjayet । sarvvaDAnyopakaraRaM gurave vinivedayet ॥ sarvvaSayyAdikaM dattvA BuYjItAtElameva hi । purARaSravaRaM tadvat kArayedBojanAdanu ॥ imaM hiraRyASvaviDiM karoti yaH puRyaM samAsAdya dinaM narendra ! । vimuktapApaH sa puraM murAreH prApnoti sidDEraBipUjitaH san ॥ iti paWati ya itTaM hemavAjipradAnaM sakalakaluzamuktaH so'Svayuktena BUyaH । kanakamayavimAnenArkalokaM prayAti tridaSapatibaDUBiH pUjyate yo'Ta paSyet ॥ yo vA SfRoti puruzo'lpaDanaH smaredvA hemASvadAnamaBinandayatIha loke । so'pi prayAti hatakalmazaSudDadehaH sTAnaM purandaramaheSvaralokajuzwam ॥” iti mAtsye hiraRyASvapradAniko nAma 280 aDyAyaH ॥
v: pu॰ hiraRyanirmito'SvaH । tulAdizoqaSamahA dAnagaDye dAnArTaM svarRAdinA 1 kalpite'Sve 2 tadAne ca । “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi hiraRyASvaviDi param । yasya prasAdAdBuvanamanantaPalamaSnute । puRyaM tiTimaTa sAdya kftvA brAhmaRavAcanam । lokeSAvAhana kuryyAt tulApuruzadAnavat । ftvigamaRqapasamBAraBUzaRAcCAdanAdikam । svalpezvekAgnimat kuryyAdDemavAjimaKa buDaH” atrAdiSabdena deSakAlavfdDiSrAdDaSivAdipujAguruftvigvaraRamaDupakedAnavedikAparicakraleKamavitAnatoraRatAkADivAsanAdi matasyapurARoktatulApuruzadAnavicitaM kaMgfhyate, svalpezvekAgnimaditi, vyAKyAtaM “sTApayedvetadamaDye tu kfzRAjanatilopari” kfzRAjinanihitadroRaparimitatiloparIti vijYeyam । “kOSeyavastrasaMvItaM kArayedDemavAjinam । SaktitastripalAdUdDa mAsahasraPalAdu buDaH । pAdukopAnahacCatracAmarAsanaBAjanEH । pUrRakumBAzwakopetaM mAlyakzuPalasaMyutam । SayyAM sopaskarAntadvadDemamArttaRqasaMyutam” । SayyopaskarA viviDAstaraRApaDAnavastraPalapuzpakuNkumakarpUrAgurucandanatAmbUladarpaRakaNkatikAcAmaravyajanAsanapatadgrahasTitapAtrAsimudrikopAnahayugalatAmraGawikAdijalapAtradIpikAvitAnAdayaH । mArttaRqasaMyutAmiti, uparyyArUQasUryyaM sOvarRamaSvaM kuryyAdityarTaH । sUryyalakzaRamuktaM brahmARqadAne “tataH sarvOzaDisnAnasnApito vedapuNgavEH । imamuccArayenmantraM gfhItakusumAYjaliH” । ihApi pUrvedyuraDivAsanaM viDAya dvitIyadivase pUrvavat puRyAhavAcanAdipUrRAhutiparyyantaM karma, guruH samApayet । aTa sarvOzaDijalasrAtaH SuklAmbaro yajamAnastriHpradakziRokftya vakzyamARamantramudIrayet । “namaste sarvadeveSa! vedAharaRalampawa! । vAjirUpeRa mAmasmAt pAhi saMsArasAgarAt । tvameva saptaDA BUtvA CandorUpeRa BAskaram । yasmAt BrAmayase lokAnataH pAhi sanAtana! । evamuccAryya gurave tamaSvaM vinivedayet । dattvA pApakzayAdBAnorlokamaByeti SASvatam । goBirviBavataH sarvAnftvijaScABipUjayet । sarvaDAnyopakaraRaM gurave viniyedayeta । sarvaM SayyAdikaM dattvA muYjItAtElameva hi । purARaSravaRaM tadvat kArayedBojanAnAdanu” । dAnavAkyaYca pUrvavadanusanDeyam, anuktadakziRezu suvarRaM dakziReti, yaTASakti suvarRadakziRA, viBavataH svaviBavAnusAraRa sarvAn sadasyAdInftvijaSca goBiH pUjayet, sarvaDAnyopakaraRamiti viniyogAt pUrvaM DAnyAsAdanaM gamyate, gurave nivedayediti, svalpa dravyadAne AcAryyAyEva aSvaM pradAya ftvigByo yaTASakti suvarRAdi dadyAt । sahasrapalAdidravyadAne tu prakftivadvyavasTA, svalpatarezvekAgnikze'pi drazwavyA” hemA॰ dA॰

s: puM, (hiraRyASvaH suvarRaGowakayuktaH raTo yatra .) zoqaSamahAdAnAntargatamahAdAnaviSezaH । yaTA, mAtsye । “Adyantu sarvvadAnAnAM tulApuruzasaMjYitam । hiraRyagarBadAnaYca brahmARqaM tadanantaram ॥ kalpapAdapadAnaYca gosahasraYca paYcamam । hiraRyakAmaDenuSca hiraRyASvastaTEva ca ॥ paYcalANgalakaYcEva DarAdAnaM taTEva ca । hiraRyASvaraTastadvat hemahastiraTastaTA ॥ dvAdaSaM vizRucakraYca tataH kalpalatAtmakam । saptasAgaradAnaYca ratnaDenustaTEva ca । mahABUtaGawastadvat zoqaSaH parikIrttitaH ॥” iti malamAsatattvam ॥ * ॥ tadviDiryaTA, -- matsya uvAca । “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi mahAdAnamanuttamam । hiraRyASvaraTaM nAma mahApAtakanASanam ॥ puRyandinamaTAsAdya kftvA brAhmaRavAcanam । lokeSAvAhanaM kuryyAttulApuruzadAnavat ॥ ftviNmaRqapasamBAraBUzaRAcCAdanAdikam । kfzRAjine tilAn kftvA kAYcanaM kArayedraTam । saptASvaM caturaSvaM vA catuScakraM sakUvaram । EndranIlena kumBena DvajarUpeRa saMyutam । lokapAlAzwakopetaM padmarAgadalAnvitam ॥ caturaH pUrRakalasAn DAnyAnyazwAdaSEva tu । kOzeyavastrasaMyuktamuparizwAdvitAnakam ॥ mAlyekzuPalasaMyuktaM puruzeRa samanvitam । yo yadBaktaH punaH kuryyAt sa tannAmnADivAsanam ॥ CatracAmarakOzeyavastropAnahapAdukAH । goBirviBavataH sArdDaM dadyAcca SayanAdikam ॥ aBAvAt tripalAdUrdDaM SaktitaH kArayecCuBam ॥ aSvAzwakena saMyuktaM caturBiraTa vAjiBiH । dvAByAmaTa yutaM dadyAdima mantramudIrayet ॥ namo namaH pApavinASanAya viSvAtmane vedaturaNgamAya । DAmnAmaDISAya BavABavAya pApOGadAvAnala dehi SAntim ॥ vasvazwakAdityamarudgaRAnAM tvameva DAtA paramaM viDAnam । yatastato me hfdayaM prayAtu DarmmEkanAma tvamaGOGanASAt ॥ iti turagaraTapradAnametat BavaBayasUdanamatra yaH karoti । sa kaluzapawalErvvimuktadehaH paramamupEti padaM pinAkapAReH ॥ dedIpyamAnavapuzA vijitapraBAvamAkramya maRqalamaKaRqalacaRqaBAnoH । sidDANganAnayanazawpadapIyamAnavaktrAmbujo'mbujaBavena ciraM sahAste ॥ iti paWati SfRoti vA ya itTaM kanakaraTaturagapradAnamasmin । na sa narakapuraM vrajet kadAcit narakariporBavanaM prayAti BUpa ! ॥” iti mAtsye hiraRyASvaraTapradAtiko nAma 255 aDyAyaH ॥
v: pu॰ hiraRyena nirmitaH aSvaH tadyuktaraTaH । tulAdizoqaSamahAdAnamaDye dAnArTaM svarRAdinA 1 kalpite suvarRamayASvayuktaraTe 2 taddAne na॰ । tadviDiryaTA “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi mahAdAnamanuttamam । hiraRyASvaraTaM nAma mahApAtakanASanam । puRyaM dinamaTAsAdya kftvA brahmaRavAcanam । lokeSAvAhanaM kuryyAt tulApurupadAnavat । ftvigmaRqapasamBAraBUpaRAcCAdanAdikam” । tulApuruzadAnavaditi, satsyapurARoktatulApuruzadAnavadveditavyam, AdiSabdasyApi pUrvavadeva vyAKyA “kfzRa jine tilAn kftvA kAYcanaM kArayedraTam । azwASvaM caturaSvaM vA catuScakraM sakUvaram । indranIlena kumBena DvajarUpeRa saMyutam । lokapAlAzwakopetaM padmarAgadalAnvitam” । atra tilAnAM raTasya ca parimARApekzAyAM puruzecCayA niyamaH prakftO parimARASravaRAt kecit tu sanniDAnAt hemahastiraTAdidAnasTitaM tilAnAM droRaparimARatvamiha badanti । kUvaraM yugADArakAzWam । Dvajo daRqaH, sa ca raTasya sOvarRatvAt sOvarRa eva taTA coparisTitena indranIlamaRimayena kalaSena yuktaH karttavyaH । lokapAlalakzaRamuktaM brahmARqadAne, “catvAraH pUrRakalaSA DAnyAnyazwO daSEva tu । kOSeyavastrasaMyuktamuparizwAdvitAnakam । mAlyekzuPalasaMyuktaM puruzeRa samanvitam । yo yadBaktaH pumAn kuryyAt sa tannAmnADivAsanam” । vitAnamatra paYcararRaM, puruza izwadevatAkAraH sOvarRaraTe sTApanIyaH । vastropAnahapAdukASca । “goBirviBavataH sArdDaM dadyAcca SayanAsanam । ABa rAttrilAdUrdDaM SaktitaH kArayed buDaH” । BAraH palasahasradvayam, etacca suvarRamAnaM DvajapuruzalAkapAlASvacakrarakzakasahitasya yeditavyam । “azwaBIraTasaMyuktaM caturBiraTa vAjiBiH । dvAByAmaTa yutaM dadyAdDemasiMhaDvajAnvitam” । hEmena siMhANkitena yuktamiti azwASvapakze, caturaSvapakze ca indranIlamayakumBo Dvaje kAryyaH, aSvadvayapakze hemasiMha iti vyavasTA । “cakra rakzAvuBO tasya turagasTAvaTASvinI । puRyaM kAlaM tataH prApya pUrvavat snApito dvijEH । SuklamAlyambaro dadyAdimaM mantramudIrayet” । hemA॰ dA॰ matsyapurARIyam ।
